examples.title: Load and save a customer
examples.description: A database record is loaded and saved by PageStore controllers.
examples.explanation: Enter an existing customer ID and leave the field. Edit and save; status and errors are Data. Unknown keys preserve the current record. Invalid drafts are not saved.

examples.title: Customer editing across windows
examples.description: Frames and connected windows edit independent drafts backed by the same database.
examples.explanation: Load the same customer in two pages. Save in one, then reload in the other. The gallery owns the only WebSocket. Changes are not pushed to other drafts automatically.
